name: Time → On Time Sync
description:
Automation to run when the time source could be (re-)synchronized.. See [`on_time_sync` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/time/#time-on_time_sync).

This automation is triggered after a time source successfully retrieves the current time. See the [DS1307 configuration example](https://esphome.io/components/time/ds1307/#ds1307-config_example) for a scenario where a network time synchronization from a home assistant server trigger a write to an external hardware real time clock chip.
